title: HSK 1.9 · 图书馆, 门票, 钱包, 下雨
focus: 门 · 球 · 书 · 口 · 杯 · 包 · 票 · 读 · 雨 · 门口 · 读书 · 商店 · 地图 · 桌子 · 晚饭 · 图书馆 · 饭店 · 商场 · 面包 · 钱包 · 走路 · 马路 · 门票 · 机票 · 打球 · 下雨 · 下车 · 杯子 · 路口 · 电视机 · 书店 · 车票 · 电影院 · 下课 · 书包 · 本子 · 课本 · 打车 · 包子
body:
Everyday places and things: shops, tickets, bags and roads. A few characters do most of the work here: 书 book, 包 bag, 票 ticket, 店 shop, 路 road, 门 door and 下 come down.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 书 | shū | book | 读书, 图书馆, 书店, 书包 |
| 包 | bāo | bag; wrap (勹 wrapping) | 面包, 钱包, 书包, 包子 |
| 票 | piào | ticket | 门票, 机票, 车票 |
| 店 | diàn | shop (广 building) | 商店, 饭店, 书店 |
| 门 | mén | door, gate | 门口, 门票 |
| 口 | kǒu | mouth, opening | 门口, 路口 |
| 路 | lù | road (足 foot) | 走路, 马路, 路口 |
| 下 | xià | down; get off; finish | 下雨, 下车, 下课 |

## Watch out

- 门 mén (door) vs 们 men (plural): 们 adds 亻 person.
- 读 dú (read) has 卖 mài (sell) on the right; 卖 vs 买 mǎi (buy): sell has an extra 十 on top.
- 本 běn (book, root) is 木 tree with a mark at the root; don't confuse with 木 or 末.

cards.Example: 请关门。 qǐng guān mén: Please close the door.
cards.Notes: A simplified picture of a two-leaf door (traditional 門). Lookalike: 们 men = 亻 person + 门 for the sound

cards.Example: 我们去打球吧。 wǒmen qù dǎ qiú ba: Let's go play ball.
cards.Notes: 王 (jade 玉 as a radical) + 求 qiú for the sound

cards.Example: 这本书很好看。 zhè běn shū hěn hǎokàn: This book is really good.
cards.Notes: Simplified from 書 (a brush 聿 over 曰); in its new form, just learn the shape

cards.Example: 你家有几口人？ nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén: How many people are in your family?
cards.Notes: Picture of an open mouth; as a radical it marks mouth and sound words (喝, 唱, 吃). Bigger 囗 is an enclosure (国, 四)

cards.Example: 来一杯茶。 lái yì bēi chá: A cup of tea, please.
cards.Notes: 木 wood + 不 for the sound (bù, close to bēi)

cards.Example: 我的包在哪儿？ wǒ de bāo zài nǎr: Where's my bag?
cards.Notes: 勹 wrapping around 巳: something wrapped up. Also gives the sound in 饱 bǎo, 跑 pǎo, 抱 bào

cards.Example: 你买票了吗？ nǐ mǎi piào le ma: Did you buy a ticket?
cards.Notes: 覀 on top of 示; learn the two parts as a stack. Gives the sound in 漂 piào (pretty)

cards.Example: 我读给你听。 wǒ dú gěi nǐ tīng: I'll read it to you.
cards.Notes: 讠 speech + 卖 (sell; traditional 讀 had 賣 as the sound part). 卖 mài vs 买 mǎi

cards.Example: 外边雨很大。 wàibian yǔ hěn dà: It's raining hard outside.
cards.Notes: Picture of raindrops falling from the sky. On top (⻗) it marks weather words: 雪 snow, 零, 雷 thunder

cards.Example: 我在门口等你。 wǒ zài ménkǒu děng nǐ: I'll wait for you at the entrance.
cards.Notes: 门 door + 口 opening = the door's opening: entrance

cards.Example: 他在北京读书。 tā zài Běijīng dúshū: He's studying in Beijing.
cards.Notes: 读 read + 书 book = read books, so to study or be in school

cards.Example: 商店几点开门？ shāngdiàn jǐ diǎn kāimén: What time does the shop open?
cards.Notes: 商 trade + 店 shop (广 building + 占 zhàn for the sound) = trading shop

cards.Example: 你有地图吗？ nǐ yǒu dìtú ma: Do you have a map?
cards.Notes: 地 land (土 earth) + 图 picture, diagram (in a 囗 frame) = picture of the land: map

cards.Example: 书在桌子上。 shū zài zhuōzi shang: The book is on the table.
cards.Notes: 桌 table (木 wood at the bottom) + 子 noun suffix, toneless zi

cards.Example: 晚饭吃什么？ wǎnfàn chī shénme: What's for dinner?
cards.Notes: 晚 evening (日 + 免 miǎn for the sound) + 饭 meal. Set: 早饭, 午饭, 晚饭

cards.Example: 我去图书馆看书。 wǒ qù túshūguǎn kàn shū: I'm going to the library to read.
cards.Notes: 图 picture + 书 book + 馆 hall (饣 + 官 guān for the sound) = hall of pictures and books

cards.Example: 这家饭店很贵。 zhè jiā fàndiàn hěn guì: This restaurant is expensive.
cards.Notes: 饭 meal + 店 shop = meal shop; big hotels are also called 饭店

cards.Example: 我们去商场买衣服。 wǒmen qù shāngchǎng mǎi yīfu: Let's go buy clothes at the mall.
cards.Notes: 商 trade + 场 open ground (土 earth) = trading ground: mall

cards.Example: 早上我吃面包。 zǎoshang wǒ chī miànbāo: I have bread in the morning.
cards.Notes: 面 flour (also face) + 包 wrapped bun = flour bun: bread

cards.Example: 我的钱包不见了。 wǒ de qiánbāo bú jiàn le: My wallet is gone.
cards.Notes: 钱 money (钅 metal) + 包 bag = money bag: wallet

cards.Meaning: to walk; to go on foot
cards.Example: 我们走路去吧。 wǒmen zǒulù qù ba: Let's walk there.
cards.Notes: 走 walk + 路 road (足 foot + 各) = walk the road: go on foot

cards.Example: 过马路要小心。 guò mǎlù yào xiǎoxīn: Be careful crossing the street.
cards.Notes: 马 horse + 路 road = road for horses and carts: street

cards.Example: 门票多少钱？ ménpiào duōshao qián: How much is admission?
cards.Notes: 门 gate + 票 ticket = ticket to get through the gate

cards.Example: 我买好机票了。 wǒ mǎihǎo jīpiào le: I've bought my plane ticket.
cards.Notes: 机 machine, short for 飞机 plane + 票 ticket = air ticket

cards.Example: 下午我们去打球。 xiàwǔ wǒmen qù dǎqiú: We're playing ball this afternoon.
cards.Notes: 打 hit, play (扌 hand + 丁 dīng) + 球 ball = to play a ball game

cards.Example: 外边下雨了。 wàibian xiàyǔ le: It's raining outside.
cards.Notes: 下 come down + 雨 rain = rain comes down. Same pattern: 下雪 to snow

cards.Example: 我们在这儿下车。 wǒmen zài zhèr xiàchē: We get off here.
cards.Notes: 下 go down + 车 vehicle = get down from the vehicle. Opposite: 上车

cards.Example: 杯子里有水。 bēizi li yǒu shuǐ: There's water in the cup.
cards.Notes: 杯 cup (木 + 不 for the sound) + 子 noun suffix

cards.Example: 在路口往左走。 zài lùkǒu wǎng zuǒ zǒu: Turn left at the intersection.
cards.Notes: 路 road + 口 opening = where roads open into each other: intersection

cards.Example: 电视机坏了。 diànshìjī huài le: The TV is broken.
cards.Notes: 电 electric + 视 look (礻 + 见 see) + 机 machine = electric viewing machine

cards.Example: 书店在商场里。 shūdiàn zài shāngchǎng li: The bookstore is in the mall.
cards.Notes: 书 book + 店 shop = bookshop

cards.Example: 车票在我这儿。 chēpiào zài wǒ zhèr: I've got the tickets.
cards.Notes: 车 vehicle + 票 ticket = ride ticket. Compare 门票, 机票

cards.Example: 电影院人很多。 diànyǐngyuàn rén hěn duō: The cinema is crowded.
cards.Notes: 电 electric + 影 shadow, image + 院 courtyard, hall (阝 + 完 for the sound) = electric-shadow hall

cards.Example: 我们几点下课？ wǒmen jǐ diǎn xiàkè: When does class end?
cards.Notes: 下 come off + 课 class (讠 + 果 guǒ) = get out of class. Opposite: 上课

cards.Example: 书包很重。 shūbāo hěn zhòng: The schoolbag is heavy.
cards.Notes: 书 book + 包 bag = book bag

cards.Example: 给我一个本子。 gěi wǒ yí ge běnzi: Give me a notebook.
cards.Notes: 本 root, book (木 tree with a mark at the root) + 子 suffix = notebook

cards.Example: 别忘了带课本。 bié wàngle dài kèběn: Don't forget your textbook.
cards.Notes: 课 lesson + 本 book = lesson book

cards.Example: 太晚了，我们打车吧。 tài wǎn le, wǒmen dǎchē ba: It's late, let's get a taxi.
cards.Notes: 打 hit (all-purpose verb: get, call) + 车 car = hail a car: take a taxi

cards.Example: 我想吃包子。 wǒ xiǎng chī bāozi: I want some steamed buns.
cards.Notes: 包 wrap + 子 suffix = a wrapped thing: stuffed bun
